answer: The cheapest real defence: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because comet only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, karst is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any echo approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
